next.name: AppleJeus
next.headline: AppleJeus: macOS-focused malware campaigns tied by vendors to North Korea's Lazarus cluster
next.in_short: AppleJeus is a campaign name that vendors tie to the Lazarus cluster. SentinelOne dates it to 2018. Kaspersky saw macOS samples in 2020. CrowdStrike names it among a North Korea-linked group's tools. Naming differs by vendor.

sentences.t: The catalogue record lists AppleJeus with the aliases Gleaming Pisces, Citrine Sleet, UNC1720 and UNC4736.
Kaspersky describes AppleJeus as a Lazarus operation. It also notes Lazarus is known as Hidden Cobra.

Kudelski Security and Sekoia list Citrine Sleet as one of six sub-clusters in their split of the Lazarus umbrella. They say this clustering is their own and that other vendors divide the activity differently.
SentinelOne describes Lazarus as a North-Korean linked threat actor.
CrowdStrike refers to AppleJeus as malware of LABYRINTH CHOLLIMA. CrowdStrike assesses that group is likely affiliated with Bureau 121 of the Reconnaissance General Bureau of the DPRK.
CrowdStrike describes the AppleJeus malware as a macOS variant.
SentinelOne refers to AppleJeus campaigns that began in 2018.
In June 2020, Kaspersky analysed new macOS samples linked to the Lazarus operation AppleJeus.
CrowdStrike's 2023 threat hunting report covers the 3CX double supply chain attack, which it ascribes to LABYRINTH CHOLLIMA.
Check which vendor's naming a report uses before comparing actors. Cluster names and boundaries differ between vendors.
